Definition: a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing)
BiblicalUsage: Karkarah is a dromedary — the swift camel, named among the beasts that will bring the exiles home. They shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations, upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to My holy mountain Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the swift beast is the picture of the gathering: the exiles come home by every road and every mount, and God provides the swiftest beast for the longest journey.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
